title: Source to sink 2 · reports[reportId].table → FROM ${tableName}
description: Follows every value that reaches `${tableName}` in reportRepository.summary (Semgrep node-postgres-sqli, src/repositories/reportRepository.js:8). The user's reportId only selects a config entry; the table name itself comes from src/config/reports.js.

cards.label: user input, admin only
cards.title: SOURCE: req.params.reportId
description: **Source:** the `:reportId` path segment of `GET /reports/:reportId` (URL-decoded by Express).
**Value here:** `reportId = 'daily'` for `GET /reports/daily` (example from docs/flows/show-report.flow.json, not run).
**Who can send it:** only users whose role is `admin` (step 2).
**Next →** used as a key into the `reports` object (step 3).

cards.label: only role admin can send reportId
cards.title: Check on the path: requireRole('admin')
description: **Control:** `requireAuth` then `requireRole('admin')` run before the controller. A valid token whose user has role `user` gets `403 {"error":"forbidden"}`. This limits who can send `reportId`, not what it contains.
**Next →** the lookup (step 3).

cards.label: used only as an object key
cards.title: User input stops here
description: **Stops:** `reportId` is only used to select an entry of the `reports` object. Its own text goes no further: nothing downstream reads `req.params.reportId` again.
**Value here:** `reports['daily']` → `{ title: 'Orders in the last 24 hours', table: 'orders_daily_summary' }`.
Because `reports` is a plain object literal, inherited keys (`constructor`, `toString`, `__proto__`) also return a truthy value whose `.table` is `undefined` (derived from code, not run).
**Next →** the value that continues is the config entry (step 4).

cards.label: source-code config, changed only by developers
cards.title: SOURCE: config/reports.js table names
description: **Source:** two hard-coded table names (views defined in `db/init.sql`). Nothing in the codebase writes to this object at runtime; it changes only through a code change.
**Possible values:** `'orders_daily_summary'`, `'orders_monthly_summary'`, or `undefined` for an inherited key (step 3).
**Next →** the selected entry becomes `definition` (step 5).

cards.title: reports[reportId] → definition
description: **Propagates:** the config entry is stored in `definition`.
**Value here:** `definition.table = 'orders_daily_summary'` (derived from code, not run).
**Next →** existence check (step 6), then `reportService.build(definition)` (step 7).

cards.label: unknown key → 404; inherited keys pass with table undefined
cards.title: Check on the path: !definition → 404
description: **Control:** a key that is not in the object returns `404 {"error":"unknown report"}`. Combined with the lookup, the table name can only be one of the two config strings, or `undefined` for an inherited key such as `constructor` (which passes this check). It is never request text.
**Next →** `definition.table` is passed to the repository (step 7).

cards.title: definition.table → summary()
description: **Propagates:** the service passes `definition.table` unchanged. `summary` has one caller (this line).
**Value here:** `'orders_daily_summary'` (derived from code, not run).
**Next →** received as `tableName` (step 8).

cards.title: definition.table → tableName
description: **Propagates:** the parameter is named `tableName` in the repository.
**Value here:** `tableName = 'orders_daily_summary'` (derived from code, not run).
**Next →** interpolated into the SQL text (step 9).

cards.label: SQL text (FROM)
cards.title: SINK: FROM ${tableName}
description: **Sink:** `tableName` is written into the SQL text with a template literal; the query has no bound parameters.

**Sink receives:** `... FROM orders_daily_summary` for `/reports/daily`, `... FROM orders_monthly_summary` for `/reports/monthly`, `... FROM undefined` for an inherited key (Postgres error → 500) (derived from code, not run).
**Path summary:** A: `req.params.reportId` (user, admin only) → used only as a key, stops. B: `config/reports.js` table names (developers only) → 404 check → `FROM` text.
